statuses.legacy: exists, being replaced by the planned branches
statuses.parked: exists and is compiled, but is kept out of pool until it has been tested

branches.name: master
branches.purpose: Untouched copy of the original project's master. Every module and fix branch is cut from it.

branches.name: pool
branches.purpose: Everything together; the branch the pool controller runs. To be built from the branches below, never edited directly.

branches.name: pool-next
branches.purpose: pool rebuilt from the branches in this list, in a fixed order. It is replaced at every rebuild; pool takes it over after testing.

branches.name: fix/body-card-width
branches.purpose: Body card layout: narrower heat settings box, smaller temperature, centered on/off box.

branches.name: feature/chlorinator-rs485-diag
branches.purpose: RS485 diagnostic view of chlorinator messages in both directions, with the Details popup.

branches.name: feature/dashboard-sun-times
branches.purpose: Sunrise and sunset beside the Schedules title, and schedule offsets.

branches.name: feature/dashboard-enhancements
branches.purpose: Older combined branch; replaced by feature/chlorinator-rs485-diag and, in dashPanel, feature/dashboard-sun-times.

branches.name: feature/temp-average-24h
branches.purpose: 24 hour average water temperature for each body.

branches.name: feature/pump-priming
branches.purpose: Priming for relay driven pumps (two speed, relay switched variable speed); off by default.

branches.name: feature/pws-weather
branches.purpose: Hourly weather log from a personal weather station, and a Weather panel.

branches.name: feature/solar-enhancements
branches.purpose: Solar log, settle delay, hysteresis, valve delay check, check period, return sensor, Solar Controls; in dashPanel also the Nocturnal Cooling toggle. Stacked on fix/solar-restart in njsPC.

branches.name: feature/pi-status
branches.purpose: The condition of the computer njsPC runs on: processor temperature, power and heat flags, processor and memory use, free storage, Wi-Fi signal, uptime, installed software, and how late njsPC itself runs, with a longer log (njsPC: GET /state/system). dashPanel: a System panel showing it.

branches.name: feature/auto-swg
branches.purpose: AutoSwg: a recommended SWG % from PoolMath readings, with Away protection. AutoSwg code only. The tagged releases autoswg-v0.1.x are the earlier form of this branch.

branches.name: feature/auto-swg-clean
branches.purpose: Earlier AutoSwg-only branch; replaced by feature/auto-swg.

branches.name: feature/auto-swg-automation
branches.purpose: Former working branch (AutoSwg plus solar, average, tools). Kept for history; no new work.

branches.name: feature/swg-assist
branches.purpose: feature/auto-swg plus the rename to SWG Assist (user-facing text only).

branches.name: local/npm
branches.purpose: package.json allowScripts and the audit-fix lock file. Not for upstream.

branches.name: audit-fix-pi
branches.purpose: Snapshot of an earlier install; fully contained in pool.

branches.name: archive/2026-10-11/*
branches.purpose: Tips of branches as they were before being re-cut on current master on 2026-10-11.
